meta.title: The Active Path
meta.subtitle: Canopy stores one number, rebuilds a whole path from it every tick, and a jump by name edits only the part of that path that actually changed

views.label: One number is the machine
views.note: The leaf is stored. Everything above it is recomputed by chasing parent pointers and reversing.

views.label: What a named jump does
views.note: There are no transition edges. A node names a state, and the machine finds the common ancestor.

views.label: Up, then down
views.note: Exits run deepest first, entries shallowest first. Anything shared by both paths is never touched.

views.label: Caught before you ship
views.note: Two roots, a missing default child, a name that hashes onto another name — all refused at bake.

cards.title: Why a path, not a state
items: Every state above the leaf is active too, and its blocks run every tick
That is why a connection watcher belongs on the root and not on a child
Parent pointers are walked up · Canopy BovineLabs.Canopy/CanopyStateMachine.cs:254
Then the list is reversed, so the root runs first · same file:267

cards.title: The jump, step by step
items: The name is resolved by scanning nodes · Canopy BovineLabs.Canopy/CanopyStateMachine.cs:270
Old and new paths are compared until they differ · same file:195
Only states below that point exit, deepest first · same file:212
Then the new branch is entered, shallowest first · same file:358

cards.title: The re-entrancy guard nobody mentions
items: Each transition bumps a version number kept in grove state
Every enter and update loop rechecks it and abandons a stale walk
So a jump fired from inside Enter wins, and the older walk stops quietly
A jump fired from inside Exit throws · Canopy BovineLabs.Canopy/CanopyStateMachine.cs:461
